text:
The Nifty 50 closed at 25,299.35, up 0.18% for the day and 5.59% over the last five sessions, while the broader Nifty 500 rose 0.36% (5‑day gain 4.82%). Advances outpaced declines (294 vs 191) giving a breadth score of 75.1, labelled “HEALTHY”. The Bank Nifty added 1.19% (10‑day rise 10.02%). Volatility eased as the India VIX fell 5.37% to 16.62.  

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) were net buyers of ₹7,831 crore, extending an 11‑day buying streak, whereas Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) sold ₹6,331 crore, marking a 9‑day net outflow. In futures, FIIs held a 37% long position but net contracts were negative (‑49,719). Sector‑wise, “leading” groups such as PSU banks, capital markets, auto and consumption drove the rally, while “weakening” areas included media, pharma and IT. Options data show a put‑call ratio (PCR) of 0.85 for Nifty (more call than put interest) and 1.28 for Bank Nifty (more put interest). The Nifty max‑pain level sits at 25,200, with a call wall at 26,000 and a put wall at 24,000.  

Watch the 25,275 point pivot (S1 25,166.6, R1 25,408.5) and the 200‑day moving average at 23,992.2 for support. Key headlines to monitor are the RBI’s three‑day Variable Rate Reverse Repo auction on Nov 13, the rupee testing the ₹94‑per‑dollar barrier, and earnings strength from banks and auto stocks that could push the Nifty toward the 26,000 level.
